changed: When you share or copy a set list with its figures, each dance's figures no longer show their beats (or bars, for an English dance), and each phrase label, such as A2, sits on a line of its own above the figures that start in that phrase. A single dance's shared or copied card still puts the phrase label and count beside every figure.

added: Add a `compactFigures` option to `danceToPlainText` (and `compact` to `danceCardFigureLines`): leaves off beat counts and puts each phrase label on a line of its own above the figures that start in that phrase.
